name: Puru Shiru 2
source:
Sexual desire disposal animals, mass-produced pull-threes, are mauled.
They are made to drink semen.

This is the second version of the same concept as the previous one.
Certain siblings illegally obtain an early-type individual that had been frozen as a prototype.
For her to be struck with young sexual desire,
There was only a future in which she would be sex-soaked.
